Name: Casks in buildings
Author: iamsaulc
Description:
[size=3][b]Would you like to be able to add casks to any of the buildings you build in the woodshop?[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]This modification will allow you to do this, you will be able to add casks to all buildings including the greenhouse, although you can configure it to your liking and disable the buildings that you don't want to be affected by this.
[b]
Configuration:[/b][/size]
[code]﻿
{
"CoopActive": true,
"Coop2Active": true,
"Coop3Active": true,
"BarnActive": true,
"Barn2Active": true,
"Barn3Active": true,
"ShedActive": true,
"Shed2Active": true,
"SlimeHutchActive": true,
"GreenhouseActive": true,
"AddBuildingKey": "Add",
"CustomBuildings": [
"FarmHouse",
"Farm_Island"
]
}
[/code]
* The [i]CustomBuildings[/i] configuration is provided as an example; you can add any building you want by editing the config.json file or by pressing the key assigned to [i]AddBuildingKey[/i] within the map where you want to enable the casks.

[size=3][i]Changing the value to [b]false[/b] will deactivate that building[/i][/size]

Downloads.Description: You can now enable the use of casks wherever you want; simply press the key configured in the config.json file, and it will activate in the map you are currently in.

Manifest.Name: Casks In Buildings
Manifest.Description: Allows casks to be placed in coops, barns, sheds, the slime hutch, greenhouse, and any custom building you want.
Manifest.Author: IamSaulC
